净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Preserves the core mechanism of lagged return amplified by log volume ratio and volatility adjustment. Adds a lightweight regime adaptation: in high residual volatility states (style_gate_resvol_high), a longer EMA smoothing (10 days) reduces noise; otherwise, the original EMA5 preserves responsiveness. This targets improved stability in turbulent periods without weakening the parent's strength.

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) raw = vol_ratio - 1 滞后量比
  2. 2) 高波动期: ema(span=10) 长窗平滑
  3. 3) 低波动期: ema(span=5) 短窗快响应
  4. 4) factor = cs_rank(...)

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. shift(close,5) — shift(n) → 滞后/移位
  2. MA30(volume) — MA30(x) → 30 期均线
  3. MA10(raw) — MA10(raw) — 用户自定义算子
  4. MA5(raw) — MA5(raw) — 用户自定义算子

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_lag_vol_volatility_adjusted_gate(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret_5 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(5) - 1 ema_vol = df_copy["volume"].ewm(span=30, min_periods=30, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() log_vol_ratio = np.log(df_copy["volume"] / ema_vol.replace(0, np.nan)) atr_20 = talib.ATR(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"], timeperiod=20) vol_adj = atr_20 / df_copy["close"].replace(0, np.nan) raw = ret_5 * log_vol_ratio * vol_adj high_resvol = df_copy["style_gate_resvol_high"] > 0 factor = np.where(high_resvol, raw.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean(), raw.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean()) df_copy["factor_lag_vol_volatility_adjusted_gate"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_lag_vol_volatility_adjusted_gate"]
